items.title: CoreWeave’s Next $10 Billion Revenue Opportunity Could Change Its Valuation
items.summary: Hundreds of thousands of GPUs will come off contract over the next two years, and CoreWeave says renewing them needs no new capex. But a heavy debt load could decide whether the market ever pays for that windfall.

items.title: Big Tech Will Be “Six of the Top Ten Issuers” of Corporate Bonds, Apollo CEO Predicts. Stocks Now Have Competition
items.summary: Key TakeawaysApollo CEO Marc Rowan predicts that hyperscalers will be six of the top ten investment-grade bond issuers in the next few years, replacing six of the top ten banks. Rowan is right that Big Tech’s bonds now compete with its stocks for income investors: Meta’s shortest new dollar note pays 5.
